messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Dear colleagues at Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.,

Thank you for your quote and for explaining your position.

Your defect rate over the last four quarters stands at 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). Our demand forecast for this part has changed +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).

We have analysed the cost situation of this part carefully; the options below reflect that analysis.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 43.91 per unit, EUR 500 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 1500 ppm.
Option B: EUR 43.24 per unit, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 1500 ppm.
Option C: EUR 43.47 per unit, EUR 150 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 1500 ppm.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We look forward to your view on these options.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Thanks for the volume update, we can do the 1500 ppm with 0 chargeback and drop the price to €46.50. 

So our offer is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. If you want a better price, we really need to talk about faster payment terms. 

The guys in the office will reply about the cost breakdown. Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
